row.evidence: TextExpander's pricing FAQ says "Enterprise adds SSO for all providers with SCIM", and its SCIM guide says "SCIM provisioning is available for organizations with our Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Status is still gated, but the June row (SCIM on Business at $10.41) no longer matches. The plans are now Free, Pro ($5/u/mo annual, up to 5 users), Business ($10/u/mo annual) and Enterprise (custom). SCIM is Enterprise-only per both the pricing page and the docs. The pricing cards show $6 and $12 per user/mo next to 'Billed annually at $60/$120', while the FAQ gives $5 and $10 annual; the annual figures are used (see conflicts). Business includes SAML SSO with Google Workspace only; other IdPs need Enterprise. SCIM works only with Okta, Microsoft Entra and OneLogin, and Support supplies the Organization ID and SCIM token. SAML users are created just-in-time by default.

operations.notes: Okta guide lists Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate Users and Push Groups (Okta groups become TextExpander Teams).

deprovision.data_retained: Users are deactivated, not deleted; reassigning in Okta reactivates them.

attributes.notes: The guide names Email, First Name and Last Name as Okta profile labels, not SCIM attribute paths.

limitations.text: SCIM works only with Okta, OneLogin and Microsoft Entra; other SAML IdPs get SSO and JIT only.
SCIM must be enabled by TextExpander Support, which issues the Organization ID and token.
Deactivating the last organization administrator or snippet group administrator fails; the user stays active in TextExpander.
Provisioning a user who already has a TextExpander account outside the organization errors.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery SSO tutorial documents JIT only; no Entra provisioning tutorial exists (404). TextExpander says Entra SCIM is available on Enterprise via Support.

google.notes: TextExpander's guide uses a Google Workspace custom SAML app.

onelogin.notes: From TextExpander's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin's catalogue page was not checked.

jumpcloud.notes: TextExpander's guide uses a JumpCloud Custom SAML App.

conflicts.text: Pricing cards show Pro $6/mo and Business $12/mo per user with 'Billed annually at $60/$120 USD', while the FAQ on the same page says Pro is $5 and Business $10 per user per month billed annually; $5/$10 match the stated annual totals and are used.

open_questions: No public user-management or admin REST API was found in the sitemaps; whether one exists is undocumented.
SCIM version, base URL, endpoints, filtering, pagination and token expiry are not documented.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees a paid seat is not stated.
How Entra and OneLogin SCIM are configured (gallery app or custom) is not documented publicly.
Whether SSO must be configured before SCIM is implied by the Okta guide but not stated as a requirement.
